# Coffi

> Coffi is an app that helps remote workers, creators and digital nomads find the right space to create in their city, based on what people at each space are sharing right now, and find their people there. Tagline: "Be where you thrive." Launching in Medellín, Colombia.

Coffi is not a social network and has no feed or people directory. You pick what you came to do today (deep focus, meetings, build mode, network and chill, and more), see how each space is doing live, and check in. Your time at a space is your room: if you choose to be visible there, people at that space can find you. Every account starts on the free Explorer plan. Nomad is the premium plan: it adds seeing who is at each space before you head out and being visible to other Nomad members across the city. Explorer lets you be found; Nomad lets you find your people before you go. Wanderlust is coming soon. Most pages have a Spanish version under /es.

## Product

- [Coffi app](https://app.coffi.com.co): The web app where you find spaces on the map, check in and earn Coffi Points.
- [Coffi home](https://coffi.com.co): What Coffi is and how it works, in English ([Spanish](https://coffi.com.co/es)).
- [Plans](https://coffi.com.co/#pricing): Compare Explorer, Nomad and Wanderlust ([Spanish](https://coffi.com.co/es#pricing)).
- [Explorer plan](https://coffi.com.co/#pricing): The free plan every account starts on, with no card needed ([Spanish](https://coffi.com.co/es#pricing)).
- [Nomad plan](https://coffi.com.co/subscribe-nomad-plan): The premium plan to see who is at each space before you go, be visible in the city and earn double Coffi Points ([Spanish](https://coffi.com.co/es/subscribe-nomad-plan)).
- [Wanderlust](https://coffi.com.co/wanderlust): A plan that is coming soon; it is not available yet ([Spanish](https://coffi.com.co/es/wanderlust)).

## How it works

- [The live map](https://coffi.com.co/#features): Find spaces by type, amenities, the vibe people are creating there and how full they feel right now ([Spanish](https://coffi.com.co/es#features)).
